market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC currently ~$77,800 on Apr 27, 2026. Window started Nov 24, 2025. 52-week low was ~$60,187 (Feb 2026 Iran-war crash). To hit $45k requires a further 42% drop in 8 months - well below any low touched so far. Possible but historically unusual without a major shock.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Tail-risk macro/geopolitical shock could trigger rapid drawdown.
